OpenAPI describes endpoints, schemas, authentication and responses; generates documentation/ testing
clients when appropriate.
OpenAPI spec එක endpoints, request fields, responses සහ security requirements describe කරනවා.
Contract එක test කරන්නතේ docs generate කරන්නතේ පුළුවන්.
API contract YAML Docs client generation Implementation Contract tests
Read the diagram: The spec describes expected behavior, not automatic implementation correctness.

openapi: 3.0.3
info: {title: Shop API, version: '1.0'}
paths:
  /health:
    get:
      responses:
        '200': {description: OK}
Expected result: A compatible OpenAPI tool can display GET /health documentation.

Interview question: Why maintain OpenAPI documentation?
Answer: It communicates the API contract and supports tooling/testing.
